name: Odesa
registryBasis: Odesa City Council’s Department of Architecture and Urban Planning hosts an official urban-planning cadastre portal and identifies its municipal urban-cadastre service. The portal explicitly says its urban-cadastre maps are blocked for public viewing for security reasons during martial law. This is city-specific planning-cadastre evidence, not confirmation of a public land-parcel register or runtime geometry route.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The city’s own portal blocks urban-cadastre maps for security reasons during martial law; no public anonymous feature schema or geometry route is available from the inspected pages. National parcel search is not Odesa-specific and was not used. Runtime remains disabled.
scopeLimits: Local evidence establishes a municipal urban-planning cadastre only. It does not establish a legal parcel registry or public parcel geometry. No owner/address/cadastral-number query was submitted.

executedQueries.query: Odesa city council official urban planning cadastre map public GIS parcel map
executedQueries.scope: Find exact-city cadastral/map sources and inspect only safe public route metadata.
executedQueries.result: Odesa City Council’s official planning-cadastre portal identifies the city architecture/planning department and says its maps are blocked for public viewing for security reasons. The Odesa regional geoportal gives the same martial-law public-viewing restriction. The national StateGeoCadastre link is not treated as an Odesa-specific runtime route; no parcel search was made.

executedQueries.query: Одеса міська рада містобудівний кадастр карти публічний перегляд земельні ділянки геопортал
executedQueries.scope: Перевірити офіційні міські кадастрові карти та безпечний публічний доступ без пошуку за кадастровим номером.
executedQueries.result: Офіційний портал Департаменту архітектури та містобудування Одеської міської ради прямо повідомляє, що карти містобудівного кадастру заблоковані з міркувань безпеки. Національна кадастрова карта в меню є посиланням, але її пошук за номером ділянки не використовувався; публічну міську геометрію не отримано.

officialSources.observation: Official Odesa City Council architecture/planning department portal says its urban-cadastre maps are blocked for public viewing for security reasons and identifies its municipal urban-planning cadastre service.
Official municipal department page referenced by the portal; supports local office identity.
Official regional urban-planning geoportal states that public viewing of its data is temporarily unavailable during martial law; it covers regional planning, not a verified city parcel layer.
